outroLine: How many did you get? Comment your score, did you beat four? Subscribe with the bell on for a new quiz every day!

lines.q: Twelve hard questions, about seven minutes. Can you score four or more? First one: how many time zones does China officially use?
lines.a: Just one! All of China runs on Beijing time, even though the country is about five time zones wide.

lines.q: Which chemical element has the symbol P B?
lines.a: Lead! The symbol comes from plumbum, the Latin word for lead, which also gave us the word plumber.

lines.q: What is the smallest country in Africa?
lines.a: Seychelles! An island nation of about four hundred and sixty square kilometres. Gambia is only the smallest on the mainland.

lines.q: What is the deepest lake in the world?
lines.a: Lake Baikal in Siberia! It is more than one and a half kilometres deep and holds about a fifth of the world's unfrozen fresh water. Four down, how are you doing?

lines.q: Round two, very hard. How many bones are in one adult human hand, wrist included?
lines.a: Twenty seven! Eight in the wrist, five in the palm and fourteen in the fingers.

lines.q: Mandarin has the most native speakers on Earth. Which language comes second?
lines.a: Spanish! Close to five hundred million native speakers. English has more speakers in total, but fewer native ones. If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: What is the most common element in Earth's crust?
lines.a: Oxygen! Almost half of the crust by weight, locked up in rocks and minerals. Silicon is a distant second.

lines.q: Which of these organs cannot feel pain itself?
lines.a: The brain! Brain tissue has no pain receptors, which is why some brain surgery can be done while the patient is awake. Eight down, four to go!

lines.q: Legend round. What does the D in D-Day stand for?
lines.a: Simply day! Military planners used D-Day for the start date of any operation, and H-Hour for its start time.

lines.q: Roughly how many times does a resting human heart beat in one day?
lines.a: About one hundred thousand times! Seventy beats a minute adds up fast. Three left, stay with me!

lines.q: How many permanent members does the United Nations Security Council have?
lines.a: Five! The United States, the United Kingdom, France, Russia and China. Fifteen is the total, including the ten elected members.

lines.q: Final question. Which is the oldest university in the world that is still operating today?
lines.a: Al Qarawiyyin in Morocco! Founded in eight fifty nine by Fatima al Fihri, and recognised by Guinness World Records as the oldest still running.
